observations: Photo 0 shows a black DSLR camera body with 'Canon' logo on top and 'EOS 80D' clearly visible on the front right side.
The camera is resting on a white box with 'EOS 80D (W)' and 'Digital Camera' printed on it.
Photo 1 shows the back of the camera with the viewfinder, buttons, and 'Canon' logo visible. The viewfinder shows a purple reflection, possibly from the sensor or mirror.
Photo 2 shows the top of the camera with the mode dial, hot shoe, and power switch. The mode dial has standard DSLR modes (P, TV, AV, M, etc.) and a green auto mode.
All photos show a watermark 'CHIVITECH DIGITALWORLD' across the images.
The camera appears to be in clean condition with no visible dents or cracks, but no internal or functional proof is shown.

claims.claim: This is UK used Canon EOS 80D body
claims.evidence: Photo 0 clearly shows 'Canon EOS 80D' on the camera body. The box also confirms the model. 'UK used' is unverifiable_remote as no proof of origin is shown.

claims.claim: it's very clean and neat as you can see in the photos
claims.evidence: All photos show the camera with no visible scratches, dents, or dirt. The body appears well-maintained.

risks.risk: Camera may not power on or have functional issues (e.g., shutter, sensor, mirror, or LCD)
risks.proof: Video or photo showing the camera powering on, shutter firing, and LCD displaying image.

risks.risk: Sensor or mirror may be dirty or damaged (not visible in photos)
risks.proof: Photo or video of the sensor or mirror under magnification, or a test shot taken with the camera.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having potential sensor/mirror issues

risks.risk: Camera may be stolen or have tampered serial number (common in used electronics)
risks.proof: Clear photo of the serial number on the camera body (usually on the bottom or side) and verification via Canon's website or authorized dealer.

proof_requests: Video or photo showing the camera powering on and taking a test shot.
Clear photo of the serial number on the camera body.
Photo or video of the sensor/mirror condition.
response.reason: The camera is clearly identified as a Canon EOS 80D and appears clean, but functional and internal condition cannot be verified from photos alone. Hidden risks like non-functionality, sensor damage, or theft require proof before pricing.
